title: Pre-commute quick hits — morning call checklist
content:
Quick pre-commute brain dump / checklist — stuff to get off my plate before noon. Mostly shorthand.

Today goals (top-line):
- 6 warm outreach calls (aim for 3 dials in first hour)
- 2 follow-up emails sent (LedgerGrid, FrostByte)
- 1 demo scheduled (OmniScale) or at least firm next-step
- Update forecast: +1 to May pipeline if OmniScale gets demo

Priority list (order):
1) OmniScale — AE-qualified, wants proof-of-concept timeline. Notes from last call: heavy inference costs concerns, security questions re: VPC/private deployment. Action: push dedicated + cost model deck, ask solutions eng for 30-min technical call. Slack ping: @samira for availability.
2) LedgerGrid — sent proposal 3/31, waiting on procurement. Billing contact changed (now: Marcello Ruiz). Action: follow-up email with contract summary, escalate to CS if no reply by EOD.
3) FrostByte (warm) — demo next week possible. Need to confirm their token volume estimate. Ask about peak concurrency.
4) NimbusHealth — moved from cold to MQA after last whitepaper send. Send health-care compliance one-pager (Private deployment KMS/HSM note).
5) TinyShop — micro-startup, trying hosted API first. Offer trial credits and quickstart.

Call scripts (short snippets) — keep natural, three lines max:
- Intro: "Hey <name>, Nora from Redwood Inference — quick check, did you get the cost breakdown I sent?"
- If pushback on cost: "Totally hear you — do you want a scenario showing tradeoffs (Dedicated vs Hosted) with throughput numbers? I can loop solutions to sketch it out."
- Close: "If it makes sense, can we pencil in 30-min next-step? I’ll bring an engineer for technical Qs."

Follow-up email snippets (copy/paste):
- OmniScale: "Marc, thanks for the time earlier. Attached is a short cost/throughput comparison for your 3 workloads and a proposed timeline for a 2-week POC. If you want, I can book a 30-min session with Samira (solutions eng) this week. — Nora"
- LedgerGrid: "Marcello — quick nudge on the vendor form. If you share the PO cadence I’ll draft a minimal SOW to speed procurement. Happy to chat 10 min. — Nora"

Quick pipeline notes (metrics to update after calls):
- Open opps to move: OmniScale (50% -> 70% if POC accepted), LedgerGrid (60% awaiting PO), FrostByte (30% to 45% after confirming tokens)
- Forecast risk: vendor procurement delay window 2–3 wks on average

Objections log (real snippets):
- "We can’t expose data to a hosted provider" -> response: "We have Private and Dedicated options with VPC + KMS"
- "Latency at scale" -> response: "Show latency SLOs, offer a Dedicated pool trial, and reference benchmark page"

Stuff to attach/send today: cost-deck-2p.pdf (trimmed), private-deploy-overview.docx, one-pager-healthcare-compliance.pdf

Time-box grid (my typical morning):
- 08:00–08:15: quick CRM updates + triage unread slack
- 08:15–08:45: 1st dial block (target 3 contacts)
- 08:45–09:00: send 2 follow-ups / upload notes to CRM
- 09:00–09:30: research next 3 accounts (org chart, tech signals)
- 09:30–10:00: second dial block / meeting prep

Reminders / notes to self:
- Pull cost numbers from Redwood Optimize examples — use the 'small-medium qps' profile for OmniScale scenario.
- Flag any security questions to @liam (SRE contact).
- Capture any feature ask into CONFLUENCE-rlw-sales-playbook with tag "ask-dev"

Micro tasks (tick when done):
- [ ] Attach POC timeline to OmniScale thread
- [ ] Ping Samira for 30-min technical slot
- [ ] Send contract summary to LedgerGrid (Marcello)
- [ ] Update CRM stage for FrostByte
- [ ] Add NimbusHealth to healthcare list (compliance doc)

Random shorthand ideas (brainstorm):
- Offer "burst capacity" example — show autoscaling + predictable reserved baseline as a sale differentiator.
- Quick win: propose a 2-week POC capped cost to reduce procurement hesitation.

Errors / blockers I might hit:
- Solutions eng calendar conflicts this week (Samira overloaded) — might need to ask for an on-call engineer or suggest recorded technical walkthrough.
- Procurement requiring MSSA review — escalate to legal via sales-ops.

Relevant links / shorthand refs:
- Playbook: CONFLUENCE-rlw-sales-playbook (search: "POC pricing templates")
- Benchmarks: internal benchmark page (ask @liam for the link)
- Slack: #ae-run for quick sync, #product-feedback for feature asks

Evening reflection (leave blank to fill later):
- Wins today? (goal: 1 demo scheduled)
- Lessons: what objection patterns repeated? what collateral helped?

End of quick hits. Keep this on my phone notes for commute calls.

---
